    # Collapsed seeds

    # Additional
    "u6jn1njs": {"name": "c_prime_v2", "group": "Other", "actual_seed": 999},
}

target_metrics = [
    "critic/score/mean",
    "critic/rewards/mean",
    "actor/ppo_kl",
    "actor/entropy_loss",
    "actor/entropy",
    "actor/grad_norm",
    "actor/pg_loss",
    "actor/pg_clipfrac",
    "response_length/mean",
    "train/AlfworldSG/success",
    "train/AlfworldSG/pass@8",
    "train/AlfworldSG/action_is_valid",
    "val-env/AlfworldSG/success",
    "val-env/AlfworldSG/pass@1",
    "val-core/unknown/reward/mean@32",
    "collapse/first_turn_valid_rate",
    "collapse_first_turn_sample/mi_estimate",
]

results = {}

for run_id, info in runs_info.items():
    try:
        run = api.run(f"xiaoyucorynne-/cost-verify-agent-rl/{run_id}")
        print(f"Fetching {info['name']} ({run_id}): {run.name}, state={run.state}")
        
        # Fetch history
        history = run.history(keys=target_metrics, samples=500, pandas=False)
        
        step_data = {}
        for row in history:
            step = row.get("_step", None)
            if step is not None:
                step_data[step] = {k: row.get(k) for k in target_metrics if row.get(k) is not None}
        
        results[run_id] = {
            "info": info,
            "run_name": run.name,
            "state": run.state,
            "num_steps": len(step_data),
            "step_data": step_data
        }
        print(f"  Got {len(step_data)} steps")
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ERROR: {e}")
        results[run_id] = {"info": info, "error": str(e)}

# Save full results
with open("/tmp/wandb_seed_history.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2, default=str)

print(f"\nSaved to /tmp/wandb_seed_history.json")
